title: 2k/3 How to stop events that were moved with Set Move position from reset their postitons when re-entering map, or loading save?

posts.author: Starsmooth
posts.body: I'm in a bit of a pickle where events that were moved in a cutscene i made that block off a entrance to an new area end up having their positions reset and block the entrance when either re entering the map, or saving, the reloading the file thats on that map. How do i keep moved events from resetting positions?

posts.author: KermexRPG
posts.body:
You can save the X and Y coordinates of those events in variables when you leave the map, when you enter again you can call a common event or use a parallel event to "re-position" the events according to the variables stored in the variables. In RPG Maker 2003 depending of the number of events that can be a bit tedious. That will work fine when moving between maps, the tricky part is when you are loading a save file. With a patch like Maniac Patch that might be a little easier to do.
EDIT: maybe your problem can be fixed with a simple switch, I'm not sure if I understood your question.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: If they're going to be in a fixed location after the movement, you can also just put an extra event at the target location with an empty first page. When the NPC arrives at the destination, disable the moving one via a switch and enable the stationary one via the same switch.
